title: The NDA is acknowledged electronically, not by DocuSign; one full signature at the end
direction: The applicant bank acknowledges the NDA as an electronic agreement — name, title and date captured, accept and move on — instead of executing it through DocuSign. No e-sign workflow runs at the NDA step. A single full signature is taken at the end of the journey, so the partner is not asked to sign through DocuSign several times.
reasoning: Recorded as DEC-005 from the 2026-08-03 meeting, decided by Joel Olivares.
acceptance_criteria: A spec change exists in react-frontend covering the behaviour in DEC-005, in the step-02-nda area.
Every requirement added or modified by that change cites [DEC-005] in its requirement text.
Each new or modified requirement has at least one scenario.
The implementation satisfies the changed spec, and the PR references this issue.

evidence.excerpt: how the customer was going to acknowledge that NDA instead of it being a DocuSign, it being an electronic agreement, capturing their name, their title, and the date like Jonathan had suggested
